title: The 3 s reveal failsafe reveals everything, so nothing below the fold animates on scroll
detail: setTimeout(all, 3000) adds .is-in to every pending [data-reveal]/[data-stagger] child, whether or not the observer is working. Probe on index.html: below-fold elements are [60 total, 0 in] at 0.3 s and [59, 59] at 3.5 s. Any visitor who reads the hero for more than 3 s scrolls into sections that are already static. That defeats Definition of exceptional #3 and spec section 3 rule 2, which is meant as a failsafe for a dead observer only. Fix: set a flag the first time the IO callback runs, and have the timer reveal all only if that flag is still false (a dead observer). Keep beforeprint as is. Add an e2e test: wait 3.5 s, scroll to the footer, and assert the footer children were not .is-in before they intersected.

title: Price count-up runs inside an aria-live region: about 17 announcements per format change
detail: .buy-price is aria-live=polite, and countTo rewrites .price on every animation frame while roll() rewrites .per. A MutationObserver counted 17 mutations for one Bag to Jar change, so screen readers can announce intermediate prices like $47 and $71. The drawer .val (aria-live) is also written twice per change by rollChanged (old text, then new). Fix: drop aria-live from the animated nodes and add one visually-hidden live region that is set once after the change ('Jar of big crystals, $95, about $15.83 per piece'). In rollChanged, add the animation without restoring the old text, or put aria-live on a hidden mirror.

title: Under reduced motion, CSS animation delays still hide content for up to about 350 ms
detail: The reduced-motion block shortens animation-duration to 1ms but leaves animation-delay in place. With fill 'backwards', elements stay at opacity 0 for their delay: .co-form children up to 320 ms, .confirm children up to 500 ms, and order-number characters at 300+25i ms. Probe on a reduced-motion confirmation counted 14, 13, 7, 3, then 0 hidden elements at 0, 100, 183, 266 and 349 ms. Spec section 3 rule 7 asks for instant or fade-only. Fix: add animation-delay:0s !important; transition-delay:0s !important to the * rule in that block.

title: Typing in Name or Email rebuilds the whole order summary on every keystroke
detail: The input handler calls renderMoney() so the step-1 badge can turn brass. renderMoney replaces summary.innerHTML (line-item images, the Edit bag listener), the schedule list and the fee cells. Probe: 9 summary rebuilds while typing 'Ava Stone'. It is wasteful on low-end phones and resets anything animating in the summary. Fix: move the step-number block into paintSteps() and call only that from the input handler.

title: Motion nits: the badge roll never runs, the flight can start off-screen, and the order number is split into letter spans
detail: (1) paintCount calls motion.roll(el, el.textContent) right after setting textContent, so roll() returns early and the badge never rolls (only the CSS bump plays). Fix: capture the old text before the update and roll from it. (2) flyToBag checks only that the bag button is on screen. Adding from the mobile bar flies a clone from the gallery image scrolled above the viewport (motion.js:187). Fix: skip the flight, or fly from the button, when a.bottom<0 or a.top>innerHeight. (3) checkout.js:403 wraps each order-number character in an inline-block span, and some screen readers read it letter by letter. Fix: put aria-label on the p and aria-hidden on the spans.

title: npm run verify is red at a8af578: two motion-coverage tests fail every run (nav, qty-note)
detail: PORT=4196 npm run verify reports 62 passed and 2 failed. motion.spec.js run twice in isolation fails the same way both times: 'nav has no motion on /' and 'qty-note has no motion on /product.html?c=amethyst'. The working tree is clean and be93863 changes no site files. The components do move: the nav underline is a transition on a::after (styles.css:569), and qty-note animates only when it is :not(:empty) (styles.css:648). The moves() detector sees neither, because it never reads pseudo-elements and checks qty-note while it is empty. Success criterion 1 (verify green) fails, so the brief's 'a test asserts it' is not met. Fix: in moves(), also check getComputedStyle(n, '::before'/'::after'). For state-gated ids (qty-note, err-sum, undo, empty), trigger the state first (for qty-note, click + nine times), then assert. Re-run verify and record the true count.

title: Scroll choreography is lost for anyone who reads the hero for 3 s: the failsafe reveals everything
where: home (all sections), product/credits; js/motion.js reveal() failsafe @ a8af578
detail: Now: setTimeout(all, 3000) runs unconditionally, so at 3.2 s all 61 pending reveals are already .is-in. Scrolling to the grid afterwards shows all 8 cards at opacity 1.00 at 60 ms, --d stagger unused; only the late entrance glints ripple. Brief item 3 never happens for a normal visitor. Should be: the failsafe fires only if the observer never reported (an ioAlive flag), or reveals only elements already in the viewport. Probe: notin 61 at 2.2 s, then 0 at 3.2 s, with no scroll. Evidence: bureau/missions/M-0005-melody-motion/evidence/polish-r1/04-grid-entry-after-3s-1440.jpg

detail: Now (working tree, before the coordinator's re-run): the footer line sits in the bottom 8% rootMargin dead zone (bottom gap 16 px at both 375 and 1440), never intersects, and with the failsafe now conditional nothing reveals it. Scrolled to the end and waited 5 s: opacity 0, on home, product and credits. Honesty copy hidden. Should be: no reveal on the footer (or rootMargin 0 for elements in the last viewport); add an e2e test that scrolls to the end and asserts every [data-reveal] reaches opacity 1. Evidence: probe p4/p5 output ('footer-small' op=0 in=false).

title: Sleep filter FLIP: one stranded card for ~200 ms, then survivors fly up and overlap it
detail: Now: 160–300 ms shows only Amethyst, still in column 2, with an empty grid; Smoky Quartz and Selenite then travel up from row 2 and at ~386 ms Smoky Quartz overlaps Amethyst. It reads as two steps plus a collision, not 'one continuous rearrangement'. Should be: start the FLIP at 0 ms alongside the 120 ms fade (not after it); movers z-index 1 above leavers; survivors whose travel is > 1 row fade-rise 8 px into place instead of sliding 300+ px. Evidence: bureau/missions/M-0005-melody-motion/evidence/polish-r1/05-sleep-flip-1440.jpg

title: Mobile add-to-bag flight launches from 700 px above the screen
detail: Now: the source image is scrolled off (top −926), so the clone travels −706 → 22 and is visible only for the last ~80 ms as a 24 px speck dropping onto the bag. Should be: if the source rect is outside the viewport, fly from the pressed button (or the mobile-bar thumb), or skip the flight. title: Price odometer doesn't reserve width: the per-piece line jumps 20 px
detail: Now: the [data-per] line moves x 910 → 930 mid-animation as the price gains a digit (polish item 7). The price also counts up rather than rolling the rightmost digit first, and the button label jumps rather than rolls. Should be: price min-width 4ch with tabular-nums and per-line positioned independently; use motion.roll for the button label. Evidence: probe pp '#7 per-line pos'.

title: Error shake hits all fields at once, including ones off-screen; blur never shakes
detail: Now: 11 inputs shake simultaneously at delay 0, and blurring an invalid field shakes nothing (spec 6.4). Should be: shake in field order with delay i*60 ms, max 4 in view, others none; one shake on blur of an invalid touched field. Evidence: bureau/missions/M-0005-melody-motion/evidence/polish-r1/10-errors-1440-dark.jpg; m5f error anims all delay 0.

title: Small motion slips: double glint, early badge, clone blends in, undo pops back
where: grid hover; product flight; drawer undo
detail: Now: (a) entrance and hover glints ignore each other: 8 glints over 4 cards in ~1 s of sweep; (b) the badge shows the new count at 42 ms rather than when the clone lands at 600; (c) the 72 px clone of the amethyst photo over the same photo reads as a hole; (d) Undo restores the line instantly with no motion; (e) shimmer veil shows a faint parallelogram edge. Should be: entrance glint respects the 1200 ms cooldown; badge roll at landing; clone gets a 3 px var(--paper) ring and --sh-2; undo line slide-in-x 12 px/220 ms; start/end the shimmer gradient at 0 alpha over 20%. Evidence: bureau/missions/M-0005-melody-motion/evidence/polish-r1/04, bureau/missions/M-0005-melody-motion/evidence/polish-r1/07, bureau/missions/M-0005-melody-motion/evidence/polish-r1/03

title: Content in the bottom 8% of the fully scrolled page can stay hidden now that the failsafe is gone (footer disclaimer seen at opacity 0)
detail: rootMargin '0px 0px -8% 0px' makes the bottom 8% of the viewport a dead zone. At maximum scroll the footer's last line (.footer-small, which carries 'not medical advice') ends up inside that zone, e.g. top=862 on a 900 px viewport where the zone starts at 828, so it may never reach threshold 0.15. With the 3 s failsafe now limited to a dead observer, nothing else reveals it. Seen once in 9 probe runs (goto, 400 ms wait, scroll to bottom: P.footer-small op=0 still at 4 s). The other runs revealed it, depending on whether lazy images were still shifting layout. The honesty line must never be hidden. Fix: when the window reaches the document end (scrollY+innerHeight >= scrollHeight-2, on a scroll/scrollend listener), add .is-in to every remaining revealable. Or drop .footer-small from the stagger. Add an e2e test that scrolls to the bottom with behavior 'instant' before images settle.

reason: Improved (one pass, ~350 ms), but the collision remains. Leavers vanish with no 120 ms fade, so 87–134 ms at 1440 shows Amethyst alone in column 2. Newcomers then fade-rise into column 2 while Amethyst is still sliding through it: at 234 ms Smoky Quartz overlaps Amethyst at 1440, and at 114 ms at 375 the two names and prices print on top of each other. title: Instant jumps lose the grid stagger: MAX_BATCH counts across groups, so all 8 cards rise and glint together
where: home #shop via hash/anchor/instant scroll; js/motion.js flush()
detail: Now: an instant scroll to the grid brings the head, chips and cards into one batch; the cards sort past index 8, all get --d 0ms, and all 8 glint at the same moment at ~980 ms, which reads as a flash, not a ripple. The CTA path (smooth scroll) is fine. Should be: apply MAX_BATCH and the index per [data-stagger] parent (count i within each parent), keeping the 8 cap per group. Evidence: bureau/missions/M-0005-melody-motion/evidence/polish-r2/06-grid-instant-jump-1440.jpg; probe p12 (16 mutations at 22 ms, all --d 0ms)

title: 375 chip row: chips beyond the visible width stay hidden until swiped, then fade in over ~500 ms
detail: Now: after the shop is on screen for 1.5 s, only 4 of 11 chips are .is-in; the rest (including Sleep) sit at opacity 0 inside the horizontal scroller, so a swipe or a filter restore shows a blank row, then a late fade (Sleep 0.05 at 100 ms, 0.83 at 200 ms). Should be: reveal the chips row as one unit (data-reveal on the row, no per-chip stagger under 600 px), or add .is-in to all chips when the row itself enters.
